title: isan-rice-yield-benchmark
description: Process-informed simulation benchmark of main-season rice in 200 districts of Northeast Thailand over 18 seasons (2008-2025) that stores the true yield components, with a leakage-safe rolling-origin forecasting pipeline: 81 features in eight groups (history, moisture, water, climate, satellite, prices, geography, maps), eight learners, a leakage audit, feature-group ablation, ground-truth recovery of grouped SHAP, in-season forecasting, conformal intervals and robustness over replicate worlds and scenarios. Companion software to the preprint "Leakage-safe, explainable multi-source machine learning for district-level rice yield forecasting: a ground-truth simulation benchmark for Northeast Thailand". All data are synthetic.
